abstract: Thirty-five patients with testicular cancer who had scrotal contamination during or prior to their primary treatment were compared with 70 patients who had undergone radical inguinal orchiectomy. The survival curves, disease-free intervals and 2-year survival rates of the two groups did not differ significantly and we do not advocate additional aggressive surgical treatment to the scrotum and superficial inguinal lymph nodes in these patients.
abstract_ja: 精巣がん患者35例を、根治的鼠径精巣摘除術を受けた70例と比較した。35例は初回治療中または治療前に陰嚢汚染があった患者群である。両群の生存曲線、無病生存期間、2年生存率に有意差はなかった。したがって、これらの患者に対して陰嚢および浅鼠径リンパ節への追加の積極的な外科的治療は推奨しない。
